operation.summary: Verify a supported device with authorized credentials and enroll it for this agent

body.name: talk_cloud_password
body.description: Optional separate authorized Tapo cloud password, encrypted privately; passive authentication only, no speaker playback

body.name: allow_http
body.description: Explicitly permit unencrypted LAN HTTP, including supplied credentials. Default false (HTTPS with normal certificate validation). Required for Tapo ONVIF.

operation.returns: Verified enrolled device and safe verification; saved only after successful protocol check. Tapo camera also appears in Devices tab, requiring existing lan_camera permission.
